seed_created_with: GPU real extraction and embeddings; shared across all modes/backends
notes: All 10000 records repeat an actual-model extracted synthetic gift source; this is a dense stress fixture, not a diverse real-user corpus.
RAM is sampled aggregate working set of one benchmark process (both warmed backend services) and both model servers; these peaks do not isolate C++ overhead.
GPU memory is device total including desktop and CUDA contexts; CPU mode forces -ngl 0 on both servers.
Failed CPU requests were stopped after recurrent CONTEXT_LIMIT; measured one failure per backend plus one failed warmup per backend, not five successful answers.
Core source hashes unchanged; diagnostic journal wrappers only captured numeric metadata, never input text.
Formal timings cover service/chat engine with actual model HTTP calls. Separate actual web HTTP smoke timings are one non-warmed request per operation.
